facts.assertion: Havering application P0592.26 at 22 Mcintosh Road was approved with conditions.
P0592.26 was decided on 8 July 2026.
P0592.26 concerns a side infill and rear extension following demolition of an existing garage, not a strategic site allocation.
Application P0749.26 at 10 Heather Gardens was Undecided on the current official record.
P0749.26 has a Decision By date of 24 August 2026 and therefore has no current final decision to infer.
Application P0467.26 at 43 Heather Avenue was approved with conditions on 23 June 2026.
P0467.26 concerns a first-floor side and rear extension and is not Local Plan allocation evidence.
Application P0010.26 at 7 Heather Drive was approved with conditions on 12 March 2026.
Application P1516.25 at 31 Tudor Avenue was approved with conditions on 5 February 2026.
Application P1480.25 at 31 The Ridgeway, Gidea Park was approved with conditions on 21 January 2026.
Certificate case D0524.25 at 406C Brentwood Road recorded PP not required and was decided on 16 January 2026.
D0524.25 concerns a certificate of lawfulness for a single-storey rear extension rather than a future-growth allocation.
Certificate case D0511.25 at 32 Mcintosh Road recorded PP is required and was decided on 28 January 2026.
Condition-discharge case Q0051.26 at 4 Pettits Lane recorded ALL DECISIONS ISSUED on 24 April 2026.
Local Development Order case LDO0001.26 at land north of Fen Lane North Ockendon records status Consultation Closed and a decided date of 27 April 2026.
LDO0001.26 concerns a data-centre campus and associated development; Consultation Closed is not treated as candidate 46142 approval or allocation.
Application P0668.26 at land at Rom Valley Way was Undecided on the current official record.
P0668.26 seeks variations to permission P0615.21 for a phased mixed-use scheme including up to 972 residential units.
P0668.26 was received and validated on 1 June 2026 and carries a Decision By date of 21 September 2026.
Current Havering application records can establish application status and scope but cannot establish candidate 46142 parcel allocation without authoritative geometry binding.
